tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: World token. Top stop of the room's sky gradient. Room palettes inside a world may shift the stops; spikes stay 3:1 against every stop.

tokens.name: sky-mid
tokens.usage: World token. Middle stop of the sky gradient, at 55% of the room height.

tokens.name: sky-bottom
tokens.usage: World token. Bottom stop of the sky gradient. Floor spikes sit on it, so it is usually the hardest contrast stop.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: World token. The world's one light source (sun, moon, lamp): two discs at glow-outer and glow-inner opacity, never over spikes.

tokens.name: spike
tokens.usage: World token. Every hazard silhouette: wall, ceiling and floor spikes, saws, spike blocks. 3:1 or more against all three sky stops. The only colour that means danger.

tokens.name: spike-edge
tokens.usage: World token. Light half of a smooth spike and the rim on moving hazards. Decoration: never the only thing that shows a hazard.

tokens.name: world-accent
tokens.usage: World token. The world's highlight: the selected ring on its theme card and the room-change flash. Never used for text.

tokens.name: trail
tokens.usage: World token. Head colour of the default trail in this world, fading to transparent. Shop trails bring their own colours.

tokens.name: particle
tokens.usage: World token. Ambient particles (dust, pollen, snow, embers, bubbles, sprinkles, stars), low opacity, behind spikes.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: UI token. Deepest ink: scrim base, outline on HUD text over the sky, letterbox around the 360 x 640 play area.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: UI token. Fill of every panel, sheet and HUD button. The same in every world: UI chrome never follows the theme picker.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: UI token. Secondary buttons, list rows and cards placed on a panel.

tokens.name: on-panel
tokens.usage: UI token. Text and icons on panel (14.9:1) and panel-raised (11.1:1).

tokens.name: on-panel-muted
tokens.usage: UI token. Secondary text on panel (8.6:1) and panel-raised (6.4:1): best score, hints, captions.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: UI token. Text drawn straight on the sky (tap hint, toasts), always with a 3px ink-900 outline because the sky changes per world.

tokens.name: score-ghost
tokens.usage: UI token. The huge live score behind the bird: white at 22%. Decoration only; never put anything to read on it.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: UI token. Primary button fill: Play, Play again, Revive. One per screen.

tokens.name: action-edge
tokens.usage: UI token. The solid bottom edge under action buttons.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: UI token. Text on action (9.2:1).

tokens.name: coin
tokens.usage: UI token. Coin icon fill and coin amounts on panel (9.2:1).

tokens.name: coin-edge
tokens.usage: UI token. Coin rim and the slot line across the coin.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: UI token. Unlocked, purchased, new best; on panel 8.3:1. Always with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: UI token. Errors and destructive menu actions; on panel 4.6:1. Never used for spikes: spikes use the world's spike token.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: UI token. Focus ring for keyboard and controller navigation, 3px outside the element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: UI token. Dims the room behind pause and game over (ink-900 at 55%).

styles.name: score-ghost
styles.usage: The live score centred behind the bird, in score-ghost.

styles.name: score-final
styles.usage: The score on the game-over panel.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Screen titles: game over, paused, shop.

styles.name: number-m
styles.usage: Coin counts, prices, ranks. Tabular figures.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label. Sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bounce wall to wall and keep away from the spikes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Secondary info on panels, setting names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints under items. The smallest size for sentences.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase badges only: NEW, LIMITED, OWNED, PREMIUM.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; icon to text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside list rows; between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (plus safe area); card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between buttons in a stack.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: HUD top offset under the status bar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large gaps on menus (logo to Play).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Tags, small chips, list-row icons.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, theme cards, shop items.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets (game over, pause, shop).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Coin pill, HUD buttons, toggles.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Resting buttons and cards: a solid drop, not a blur. Action buttons draw the drop in action-edge.

tokens.name: lift-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed: the element moves down 3px and the drop shrinks.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and controller focus, in the focus colour.

size.note: Logical pixels in the 360 x 640 game viewport; Godot scales them per phone.

tokens.name: viewport-w
tokens.usage: Logical width of the play area.

tokens.name: viewport-h
tokens.usage: Logical height of the play area.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable area: HUD buttons, close buttons.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Height of full-width buttons.

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: Icons inside pills and tags.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: bird
tokens.usage: Drawn character size. The hitbox is 28px for every character.

tokens.name: spike-depth
tokens.usage: Drawn wall-spike depth (hitbox 26px).

tokens.name: spike-base
tokens.usage: Drawn wall-spike base (hitbox 30px).

tokens.name: glow-outer
tokens.usage: Outer disc of the world's glow.

tokens.name: glow-inner
tokens.usage: Inner disc of the world's glow.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Clouds and background props.

tokens.name: spike-shade
tokens.usage: Black over the dark half of a smooth spike.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Locked items and disabled buttons, always with a lock icon or a price.
